The resulting ranks give the table in every characteristic, with the only rank drop occurring when 2=0.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact classification over the natural 16-center-subset family, not merely a recomputation of the four-point example. It identifies which geometric configurations produce a characteristic-two jump: adjacent pairs and three-center subsets jump, opposite pairs do not. The result gives a precise boundary map for when the section space survives, useful for understanding the mechanism in the motivating characteristic-dependent example.
